name: Dabigatran etexilate
route_note: oral capsule twice daily, swallowed whole; pellets for children

discovery.note: Dabigatran was designed as a direct thrombin inhibitor; the etexilate double prodrug was needed for oral absorption.

tagline: First DOAC for atrial fibrillation, with its own antibody antidote
summary: Dabigatran etexilate is an oral prodrug of dabigatran, a direct, reversible thrombin inhibitor. It was the first direct oral anticoagulant approved for stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation and is the only one with a specific antibody reversal agent, idarucizumab.
mechanism: After absorption, esterases convert dabigatran etexilate to dabigatran, which binds the active site of thrombin (factor IIa). It inhibits free and clot-bound thrombin and thrombin-induced platelet aggregation.
Blocking thrombin prevents conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin. Idarucizumab, a humanised antibody fragment, binds dabigatran with very high affinity and reverses its effect within minutes.
uses: Stroke prevention in non-valvular atrial fibrillation
Treatment and secondary prevention of DVT and PE
VTE prophylaxis after hip or knee replacement

history.title: EU approval
history.detail: Approved in the EU for VTE prevention after orthopaedic surgery.

history.title: RE-LY
history.detail: The 150 mg dose is superior to warfarin for stroke prevention in AF, with similar major bleeding.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: Approved in the US for stroke prevention in AF (October), the first DOAC for this use.

history.title: Mechanical valves
history.detail: RE-ALIGN is stopped early for excess events; dabigatran is contraindicated with mechanical heart valves.

history.title: Litigation settlement
history.detail: Boehringer Ingelheim settles thousands of US bleeding lawsuits for about $650 million.

history.title: Antidote
history.detail: The FDA approves idarucizumab (Praxbind) for dabigatran reversal.

history.title: US generics
history.detail: Generic dabigatran capsules launch in the US.

pk.metabolism: Esterase hydrolysis of the prodrug; dabigatran is not CYP-metabolised; P-gp substrate

safety.boxed_warning: Premature discontinuation increases the risk of thrombotic events; spinal/epidural haematoma may occur with neuraxial anaesthesia or spinal puncture.

facts: Capsules should not be opened, because doing so can increase absorption by up to about 75%.
Its tartaric acid core is included to improve absorption and contributes to dyspepsia.

references.title: Connolly SJ et al. Dabigatran versus warfarin in patients with atrial fibrillation (RE-LY). N Engl J Med 2009
